verdict.rationale: Railway's own site directly claims rollback to any previous version instantly, which matches the core of the story. The evidence is a single marketing line, and the 'one-click' interaction is implied by 'instantly' rather than stated. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs describing the rollback flow and its one-click UI or CLI mechanics, and independent or hands-on corroboration that rollback works as claimed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll back a deployed service to any previous version in one click

citations.quote: Rollback to any previous version instantly when something breaks.
